$comment: Demo-only variant of mitre-f3-technique-flat over Frameworks/f3-excel-v1.2.xlsx, Techniques sheet. Keeps the shipped recipe and its digest unchanged, and all identities under mitre-f3. The existing regex filter captures the prefix before a dot, or matches the empty end of a top-level id: no self-parent, empty link, or no-match warning. Tactic ids split into real wikilink lists pointing at the companion Tactics-sheet import. Children lists enrich the 55 sub-technique relations in v1.2. No new template filter or F3-to-ATT&CK mapping.
